title: EU pushes back Tesla ‘Full Self-Driving’ vote meeting again, now set for December 15
summary: The EU committee that could approve Tesla’s “Full Self-Driving,” now sold in Europe as Tesla Assisted Driving, across the whole bloc won’t meet on December 1 as planned. The meeting is now December 15. A European Commission spokesperson confirmed the new date to Reuters. The Technical Committee on Motor Vehicles (TCMV) has already discussed Tesla’s file at two meetings without putting it to a vote. more…

title: NIO targets 10,000 battery swap stations and $52B in batteries by 2030
summary: NIO says its energy arm, NIO Power, will operate more than 10,000 battery swap stations and manage over RMB 350 billion ($52 billion) worth of battery packs by 2030. That’s more than double the swap network NIO runs in China today. And it comes from a company that already missed its last big swap station target. more…

title: Tesla quietly sets up a company at German machine maker EMAG’s HQ
summary: Tesla has registered a new German company whose business address is the headquarters of EMAG, a struggling machine-tool maker that builds production equipment for the gears inside humanoid robots. Neither company confirmed a deal. But the paper trail is hard to ignore, and it lines up neatly with Tesla’s push to mass-produce Optimus. more…

Deliveries are beginning in the UK before expanding across Europe. more…
